persona.goal: who-spoke-when + word-aligned per-turn transcripts, drop low-quality turns
persona.opening_prompt: For these recordings I want to know who spoke when, with the words lined up to each speaker's turn, and I'd like to drop any turn that sounds bad.
persona.preferences: General quality is fine for the drop threshold. Approve a plan that diarizes, aligns transcripts, merges them per turn, and filters quality.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For these recordings I want to know who spoke when, with the words lined up to each speaker's turn, and I'd like to drop any turn that sounds bad.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
I've grounded the full pipeline against the catalog. The request decomposes cleanly into supported capabilities:

- **who spoke when** → diarization. With no HuggingFace token available in this environment (`available_secrets: []`, and `PyAnnoteDiarizationStage` is `needs_hf_token`), the local-ready choice is `InferenceSortformerStage` (assumes ≤4 speakers, English-conversational, 16 kHz).
- **words lined up to each speaker's turn** → `VADSegmentationStage` → `SplitASRAlignJoinStage` (emits the top-level `alignment`) → `MergeAlignmentDiarizationStage` (merges word alignments into the diarization turns). This is the catalog's sanctioned "who-said-what" flow.
- **drop any turn that sounds bad** → a per-segment quality gate (`UTMOSFilterStage`, overall perceptual MOS) on the diarization turns.

Every stage exists and the roles compose. The **one** thing I can't ground without you is the quality bar: "sounds bad" is preference-dependent, and the skill forbids me from hand-picking a threshold — I resolve it from the level you choose. So one question before I emit the recipe:

**How strict should "sounds bad" be for dropping a turn?**
- **Studio-clean** — keep only pristine turns (drops the most).
- **General / usable** — keep normal-quality speech, drop noticeably degraded turns.
- **Only clearly-bad** — keep almost everything, drop only turns that are obviously poor (highest retention).

Tell me which level (studio / general / only-clearly-bad) and I'll `resolve` it to the exact `UTMOSFilterStage` setting, `validate`, and hand you the runnable recipe.

card.summary: Rejoin transcripts/alignments of previously split audio back into the original file's metadata.

good_for: recombining chunk-level transcripts/alignments after SplitLongAudioStage + an aligner
avoid_for: audio that was never split

params_of_note.text_key: transcript text key in the split entries (default text)
params_of_note.split_filepaths_key: key holding the split file paths

notes: Adjusts timestamps and concatenates transcripts to recreate the original audio's metadata. Used inside SplitASRAlignJoinStage.

contract.description: Stage for joining metadata of previously split audio files.

params.name: text_key
params.description: Key used for transcript text in split entries. Defaults to ``"text"`` for backward compatibility.

card.summary: Split long audio files into smaller pieces at natural pauses to keep speech coherent.

good_for: breaking very long recordings before ASR/alignment (memory + accuracy)
avoid_for: already-short clips

params_of_note.suggested_max_len: target maximum chunk length in seconds (default 3600)
params_of_note.min_len: minimum length for any split segment (s)

notes: Emits split file paths/metadata under split_* keys, later recombined by JoinSplitAudioMetadataStage. Used inside SplitASRAlignJoinStage.

contract.description: Stage that splits long audio files into smaller segments.

params.name: suggested_max_len
params.description: Target maximum length for audio segments in seconds

params.name: min_len
params.description: Minimum length for any split segment

card.summary: Convert to mono and (optionally) verify/resample to a target sample rate.

good_for: normalizing stereo/multi-channel input to mono before models
first step of a quality-filter chain
avoid_for: data already mono at the target rate

params_of_note.strict_sample_rate: if True, enforce the target rate

contract.description: Audio mono conversion and sample rate verification stage.

params.name: output_sample_rate
params.description: Expected sample rate in Hz (default: 48000)

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for audio file path

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the in-memory mono waveform tensor.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the waveform sample rate.

params.name: is_mono_key
params.description: Key where the mono flag is written.

params.name: duration_key
params.description: Key where the audio duration in seconds is written.

params.name: num_samples_key
params.description: Key where the number of samples is written.

params.name: output_audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key where the written mono WAV path is stored (write_to_disk=True only).

params.name: original_audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key preserving the pre-conversion path when update_audio_filepath=True.

params.name: strict_sample_rate
params.description: If True, reject audio with wrong sample rate

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: keep_waveform_in_task
params.description: If True (default), store the mono waveform and sample rate in task.data for downstream in-memory consumers.

params.name: write_to_disk
params.description: If True, write the converted mono audio to a WAV file. write_to_disk without output_dir writes WAV files to the system temp dir and nothing cleans them up; in multi-node runs point output_dir at a shared filesystem.

params.name: update_audio_filepath
params.description: If True (with write_to_disk), repoint audio_filepath_key at the written mono WAV and keep the old path under original_audio_filepath_key.

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory for the written WAV files (default: system temp dir).

card.summary: Normalize task data at the output boundary: build original_file/start/end/duration and copy passthrough keys.

good_for: producing a clean, consistent output-manifest schema before writing/extracting
avoid_for: mid-pipeline (place it near the output boundary)

params_of_note.passthrough_keys: extra input keys to copy through to the output (beyond the core fields)

notes: Core fields (original_file, original_start_ms, original_end_ms, duration_ms, duration) are always written; passthrough_keys controls what else is carried over.

contract.description: Normalize task data at the pipeline output boundary.

params.name: passthrough_keys
params.description: Keys to copy from input to output. Defaults to all built-in quality filter and speaker metadata keys.  Override to include custom fields or restrict the output schema.

card.summary: Resample/convert audio to a target sample rate (and format) via ffmpeg.

good_for: normalizing a mixed-sample-rate corpus to a model's expected rate (e.g. 16 kHz for ASR)
avoid_for: data already at the target rate (skip to save I/O)

notes: Requires ffmpeg on PATH. Placing resample once, upstream, avoids each model stage re-resampling.

contract.description: Stage for resampling audio files in a TTS/ALM dataset.

card.summary: Silero VAD: detect speech and emit one segment per speech chunk (fan-out or nested).

good_for: removing silence
chunking long audio into utterances
per-segment quality scoring
avoid_for: when you want whole-file scores (skip VAD entirely)

params_of_note.nested: True = one task with all segments under segments_key; False = fan-out one task per segment

comparison.known_limitations: VAD only (no speaker labels); changes granularity to per-segment

contract.description: Stage to segment audio using Voice Activity Detection (VAD).

params.name: min_interval_ms
params.description: Minimum silence interval between speech segments in milliseconds.

params.name: min_duration_sec
params.description: Minimum segment duration in seconds.

params.name: max_duration_sec
params.description: Maximum segment duration in seconds.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Voice activity detection threshold (0.0-1.0).

params.name: speech_pad_ms
params.description: Padding in ms to add before/after speech segments.

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the input audio file path.

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key to get waveform data.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key to get sample rate.

params.name: segments_key
params.description: Key where the nested segments list is written (nested=True).

params.name: start_ms_key
params.description: Key where each segment's start time in milliseconds is written.

params.name: end_ms_key
params.description: Key where each segment's end time in milliseconds is written.

params.name: segment_num_key
params.description: Key where each segment's index is written.

params.name: duration_key
params.description: Key where each segment's duration in seconds is written.

params.name: original_file_key
params.description: Key carrying the source file path for provenance.

params.name: nested
params.description: If True, return one task with all segment dicts under segments_key instead of fanning out one task per segment (default False).

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: keep_segment_waveform_in_task
params.description: If True (default), store each segment's waveform in the segment item. If False, nested segments are metadata-only — waveform consumers such as SegmentConcatenation will skip them.
